topicName: Cloud Infrastructure Penetration Testing (AWS, Azure, GCP)
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Cloud Infrastructure Penetration Testing (AWS, Azure, GCP)"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Cloud infrastructure penetration testing requires a systematic approach to identify security misconfigurations, identity and access management (IAM) flaws, and exposed resources across major cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and GCP."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. AWS Reconnaissance and Enumeration"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"When assessing an AWS environment, enumerating the AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) structure and publicly exposed S3 buckets are primary objectives."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"aws iam get-account-summary --profile target-profile"},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Check for overly permissive IAM policies allowing '*' actions on '*' resources."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Identify public S3 buckets using tools like Pacu or AWS CLI bucket listing."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Azure Security Assessment"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"Azure security assessments focus heavily on Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), role-based access control (RBAC), and exposed storage accounts."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"az role assignment list --all --output table"},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Inspect Azure Managed Identities for privilege escalation vectors."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Verify if Azure Storage blobs allow anonymous public read access."},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"3. GCP Project Enumeration"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Google Cloud Platform assessments involve checking project-level permissions, service accounts, and Google Cloud Storage (GCS) bucket permissions."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"gcloud projects get-iam-policy project-id"},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Look for service accounts with excessive permissions (e.g., Owner or Editor roles)."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Check for public GCS buckets using gsutil commands."},{"order":18,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":19,"type":"paragraph","text":"Cloud penetration testing helps organizations secure their dynamic environments by finding misconfigurations before malicious actors do. Always ensure you have explicit authorization before testing any cloud environment."}]
